_comment: 1906 Vol 1 South Division (downtown Loop south). VOLUME-SCOPED. Seeded: centerline spelling fixes (LASALLE->LA SALLE, VANBUREN->VAN BUREN) + documented renames (12TH->ROOSEVELT 1919, CASS->WABASH 1937, AUSTIN->HUBBARD 1930s pending inference confirmation - NOT seeded). Mysteries (LYDIA, EAGLE, WALDO, MERIDIAN, PEARCE, ROBERTS, TOWNSEND, BOSTON...) left to geometric inference; many vanished under later construction.
_comment2: Extension 2026-07-25 (5TH through HARMON PL): 'Chicago Streets', William Martin 1948 (CHM street-name-changes list, http://chsmedia.org/househistory/nameChanges/start.pdf, accessed 2026-07-25). Each entry was spot-checked against the sheets. MARKET->WACKER: the S stretch is the post-1948 Wacker extension along the old Market alignment. Deliberately NOT aliased: ARGO AV.
